text: Phone notifications: messages, new followers, likes and comments, trades closed in profit and leaderboard moves. A new device that logs in to your account sends you a security email.
Community: tap a name on the leaderboard to open that member's profile, then follow or message them.

When a broker's servers are down for maintenance, FTM keeps managing open trades and restarts copying by itself as soon as the broker is back. Members get an email and a phone notification when copying runs again.
Comments in Community now take emoji and stickers.
Free accounts can now see the leaderboard.

Every figure on the dashboard has a small i that explains exactly how it is calculated. Profit this year is time-weighted, so deposits and withdrawals do not change it; drawdown is measured on the closed balance.
The Year by year table on Performance is simpler: start, net deposits, profit, end and return for each year, with every month in the table below it.
The monthly Letter from FTM: every member gets the month's figures and what changed, in their own language.
Every evening FTM news in Community shows the FTM master account's result of the day, trade by trade, and members get it by email. On Fridays also the week, and on the 1st the month before.
Community posts now fit small phone screens exactly.
Service status: one page shows whether every FTM service is running now, with 90 days of hourly checks. Find it at the bottom of the homepage and in Customer support.
Calendar: a day's pop-up now carries the FTM logo, the account's balance and its risk profile. Closing a trade's details takes you back to that day, not to the calendar.
Performance has a new Trade statistics section: winning, losing, long and short trades, trades per day, week and month, the busiest day, streaks, time in a trade and the most traded market.

Trade statistics now also show when FTM started trading on the account, its last trade, days without trading, the longest pause, open trades, trades this week and month, markets traded and lots traded.
Homepage on phones: the FTM MACHINE chart now sits under "Made for busy people", and the FTM Investment timeline rises from Day 1 at the bottom to Year 5 at the top.
Homepage on phones: the Performance section now shows the two key figures, average yearly return and profitable years.
Homepage: the Markets section now shows the five markets FTM trades: forex, stocks, commodities, crypto and stock indices.
Homepage: smiling faces of FTM members now surround "Join 50K+ people worldwide", and the support example shows how to set up FTM MACHINE.
Phone menu: Get started and Create a free account now sit at the bottom of the menu; Log in stays at the top of the screen.
Homepage: the "Power of MT5" block is removed; "Trade the way you want" now leads with defined risk on every trade.
Homepage: the closing headline now reads "Join other people worldwide".
Homepage: the FTM score line now reads "4.5 out of 5 based on Performance".
